decision_conditions:
Reason : 1 - The proposed development, by virtue of the excessive scale and unarticulated massing of the ground floor rear extension, together with the dominant and unsympathetic roof extension and the loss of the characteristic brick front boundary wall, would result in visually intrusive additions that fail to appear subordinate to the host property or respect the established character of the terrace, contrary to Policy D1 (Design) of the Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy 2 (Design and character) of the Fortune Green and West Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2015.
Reason : 2 - The proposed basement, by reason of its excessive scale and siting, would fail to achieve subordinance to the host property, and in the absence of sufficient information to demonstrate otherwise, the Council cannot be satisfied that the proposed basement development would not cause harm to the structural stability of neighbouring properties or avoid cumulative impacts on ground and structural stability or the water environment of the local area, contrary to policy A5 (Basements) of the Camen Local Plan 2017.
Reason : 3 - The proposed basement/ground floor unit, by reason for inadequate daylight and sunlight and restricted outlook, would result in a poor standard of accommodation for future occupants, contrary to Policy D1 (Design) and H6 (Housing choice and mix) of the Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Reason : 4 - The proposed ground floor extension, by reason of its depth, height, bulk, and mass would cause harm to the residential amenity of the neighbouring property at No.9 Hillfield Road by way of sense of enclosure, loss of outlook, and loss of daylight/sunlight, contrary to Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Reason : 5 - The proposed bin store, by reason of its location adjacent to the public footway and its potential to give rise to conflict with pedestrians using the footpath through obstruction and reduced accessibility, would pose harm to public safety, contrary to Policy T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport) of the Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Reason : 6 - The application has failed to demonstrate that the proposed development is exempt from, or will otherwise achieve, the mandatory biodiversity net gain requirements, specifically, the applicant has not provided an acceptable explanation for the exemption, or a Biodiversity Gain Plan or the required biodiversity metric assessments to guarantee the necessary habitat uplift, contrary to the requirements of Schedule 7A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, the Environment Act 2021 and Policy A3 (Biodiversity) of the Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Reason : 7 - In the absence of a legal agreement securing a Construction Management Plan, construction impact bond and an implementation and monitoring fee, the development would be likely to give rise to conflicts with other road users and be detrimental to the amenities of the area generally, contrary to policies G1 (Delivery and location of growth), A1 (Managing the impact of development), A4 (Noise and vibration), CC4 (Air quality), T3 (Transport infrastructure), T4 (Sustainable movement of goods and materials), and DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Reason : 8 - In the absence of a legal agreement to secure a car-free development, the development would be likely to contribute unacceptably to parking stress, environmental impacts and congestion in the surrounding area, contrary to policies T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport), T2 (Parking and car-free development) and CC1 (Climate change mitigation) of the Camden Local Plan 2017 and Policy 7 (Sustainable development) of the Fortune Green and West Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2015.
Reason : 9 - In the absence of a legal agreement securing financial contributions towards off-site cycle parking provision, the development would fail to provide for sustainable and active transport modes, contributing to a reliance on private motor vehicles, contrary to policies contrary to policies T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport) and CC1 (Climate change mitigation) of the Camden Local Plan 2017 and policy 8 (Cycling) of the Fortune Green and West Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2015.
description: The adaptations and extension to the existing residential properties at 7 Hillfield Road and the introduction of two new residential units. The proposal seeks approval for a basement extension, extension of the rear elevation to the ground floor, introduction of a new dormer to the roof, garden outbuilding and adaptations to internal arrangements.
